title: American Greed
description:
S5 E5 — A Most Generous Criminal
Trusted adviser and a philanthropist Bob McLean runs a successful investment firm and donates millions to his favorite causes, but he carries with him a dark, devastating secret.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E19 — Lesson in Greed; Soldier Scam
A school supply vendor steals millions from Detroit public schools by enlisting shady school officials; crooks use photos of real military men to lure women into sending them love and money.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E13 — Deadly Black Gold Riches
James Henrikson schemes to strike it rich in the North Dakota oil fields, and he lets no one get in his way; when they do, they die.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E8 — Fouled Out: Rumeal Robinson
A former champion basketball player's schemes land him in prison and his mother is kicked out of her home.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E10 — Junk in a Box; Been Caught Stealing
Cancer charities that raise millions but gives only three percent to patients and families; a family brings in millions by shoplifting in a nationwide crime spree caught on camera.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E1 — Deadly Gold Digger
A femme fatale, with a way of getting men to do what she wants, sets a trap for a multi-millionaire divorcee.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E2 — The Real "War Dogs"
Miami party boys turned arms dealers bid on government contracts worth millions to fight the war on terror, inspiring the 2016 film "War Dogs.".

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E18 — Diagnosis: Blood Money; Chicago Jailbreak
A Michigan doctor treats cancer-free patients with poisonous chemotherapy and takes millions in payment; two Chicago-area bank robbers repel 17 stories to escape the Metropolitan Correctional Center.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E13 — The Bad Neighbors
A neighborhood ice cream parlor in West Roxbury, Mass., lands the Palladino family in a major case of fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E12 — Jamaican Lottery Scam
U.S. law enforcement teams up with Jamaican authorities to stop criminals using call centers in Jamaica to flood the U.S. with lies about lottery millions won by unsuspecting victims.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E7 — Sick Profits; Hollywood Swinging
A mother and son score millions in the Bay Medical Clinic scam; Gigapix collects millions from would-be movie producers before being revealed as a fraud.
